borabora: French Polynesia as a whole: Tahiti (Teahupo'o on the southeast coast, plus Papara and Taapuna), Moorea, and Bora Bora, which has only minor reef-pass surf. Describe by island and name the break. Do not treat Bora Bora as the whole place.
belfast-giants-causeway: Northern Ireland as a whole, not only Belfast and the Giant's Causeway.
komodo: Komodo & Flores as a whole, not only Komodo Island.
punta-cana: Dominican Republic as a whole, not only Punta Cana.
havana: Cuba as a whole, not only Havana.
snowdonia: Wales as a whole, not only Snowdonia.
quebec-city: Quebec City & Montreal as a whole, not only Quebec City.
napa: Napa & Sonoma as a whole, not only Napa Valley.
thailand: Phuket & the Andaman Coast as a whole, not only Phuket and its islands.
